decision_reason: Source F1/F2 still prevent a validated literal generator and production model. findings.title: Run metadata confuses independent QA with executor output and retains stale result pointers
findings.detail: Recursive collection labels 198 independent QA paths as executor outputs. run.comparison_result points to jags_attempt5 and run.todo_evidence to revision1, while new revision2 results exist. Inclusion by hash does not transfer authorship or establish execution.

held_source_decisions.counterexample: N=A=1, active manufactured count=1, active stolen count=0, tau=nu=0.5: source m=0.999, pA=0.0005 and pW=499.5. The parent event has positive mass; literal full-source JAGS rejects invalid active parents.
held_source_decisions.consequence: Zeroing invalid states is only a diagnostic kernel, not evidence of a normalized likelihood or an exact generator. No clamp, redraw or new normalization was accepted.

held_source_decisions.counterexample: Z=1, N=2, A=1, W=2, tau=nu=0.5 gives joint observation mass 1/32 while A+W>N. Binomial parameter validity does not enforce electoral physical support.
held_source_decisions.consequence: Joint algebraic margins and generation attempts cannot be certified as feasible electoral counterfactuals. Dobs=1 for N=1,A=0,W=0 is an algebraic offset, not a compatible observed leader margin.

protocol_assessment.preflight_origin: COORDENADOR, not user; corrected by separate errata without editing v2
protocol_assessment.seed_note: The conditional instruction to use 31202:31205 applied only if v1 scientific runs existed. Raw execution chronology supports retaining the v2 preregistered 31102:31105.
protocol_assessment.mcse: Correct pooled variance of four independent per-chain means estimated using 40 nonoverlapping batches of size 50: sqrt(sum(var(batch_means_c)/40))/4. Recomputed exactly from saved draws; sensitivity to batch sizes 25/100 is explanatory only, not new acceptance tuning.
protocol_assessment.ess_rule: bulk and tail ESS >= 400 for every nonconstant target
protocol_assessment.reruns: Attempts 4/5 repair exact-positive-support constant classification and NA status handling, not model, seeds, iterations or thresholds. Earlier failures were method/column extraction/name bugs. The initial deterministic NA was inherited R vector-name indexing, distinct from exact or floating probability invalidity.
protocol_assessment.limits: Twelve candidate test commands retain logs and exit codes; declared real times total 6.46 s, maximum 0.81 s, consistent with raw execution records. No timeout/restart of a live process was observed.

saved_draws_assessment.resolution_scope: A single authorized new conditioned run, not recovery of missing old draws, persisted four chains and was reopened by another process. Independent QA reopens the same RDS, verifies hashes/metadata and recomputes all 8000 joint functionals. Diagnostic correctness is the distinct open DIAG-01 finding.
saved_draws_assessment.S_explanation: With A=0, active pW=(1+s)/2. Active s=1 implies W=0 has zero probability. All positive conditional support has active s=0; class 1 also has S=0.
saved_draws_assessment.tail_ess_explanation: Each NA corresponds to a constant quantile indicator at a discrete atom. This is not automatic nonconvergence, but the frozen all-target diagnostic criterion remains unsatisfied. No substitute diagnostic is silently accepted.
saved_draws_assessment.conditioning_note: Effects, coefficients and pi auxiliaries supplied as data are conditioned, not initial values. Four counts and Z are stochastic. Unconditioned hierarchical inference and missing-response generation are not validated by this case.

todo_assessments.scope: 32 generation-auditor attempts reproduce with all attempts conserved; no hidden redraw or added clamp. A successful finite sample does not remove F1/F2 or certify a faithful complete generator.

Independent 87-cell small-N diagnostic enumeration agrees with full and factorized implementations, maximum absolute error 6.106226635438361e-16. All 29 published cells and 48 conditioned states reproduce. Normalization of the unrestricted literal likelihood remains blocked by F1.

Six Exp(5) variances, reciprocal precisions, alpha+b0, six effects, discrete counts, .999 source transformation, partial pi order, wrapper mapping and draw-wise aggregation checked. Algebraic functionals pass, but electoral physical counterfactuals do not acquire validity. No exact Stan implementation or gradient check claimed.

Conditioned JAGS versus exact enumeration satisfies the preregistered mean rule. Diagnostic shape must be repaired; nine tail ESS remain undefined. No cross-engine or full hierarchy equivalence established; JAGS is a literal software reference only.

independent_work.numeric_invalidity_note: At nu=1, N=A=3, three rationally zero boundaries evaluate negative in binary64. They remain numerically invalid; no probability tolerance/clamp validates them. These auxiliary arithmetic cases do not assert JAGS full-model generation, and nu=1 is a saturation boundary.
independent_work.active_inactive_note: Literal full-source probes reject active invalid parents but accept tested inactive invalid component expressions; all four counts remain present. Short successful updates do not reveal every internal proposal or prove unrestricted support safety.
independent_work.missing_response_note: a/w missing cases are explicitly labeled, not interchangeable with observed-response comparisons. A short successful fully missing-response probe is not generator certification.
independent_work.qa_failures_preserved: Initial quadrature tolerance/kink and wrapper strict type/attribute comparator failures are archived with scoped postprocessing corrections. Revision2 diagnostic comparison exits 1 due eleven real candidate mismatches; subsequent shape counterexample isolates the cause. Early explanatory mass-equality flags are superseded only by structural quantile-indicator checks, with originals retained.
